items.text: Pittsburgh (Tue practice): DNP - OLB Alex Highsmith (ankle; McCarthy: 'tough for him to make it'), WR Ben Skowronek (calf). LIMITED - OLB Nick Herbig (hip/ribs, missed Wk11). FULL - WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, in IR window, expected back). IR - LG Mason McCormick (ankle). Aaron Rodgers starts.

Denver (early week): S Brandon Jones (hamstring) has missed 3 games; DL Sai'vion Jones uncertain. IR - RB RJ Harvey (knee), TE Caleb Lohner, LB Jonah Elliss; RB Tyler Badie window opened. Bo Nix starts.
